milestones.title: CellStyle + GridColumn
milestones.description: CellStyle record with constants. GridColumn<T> record with factory methods (text, intCol, doubleCol, column) and builder-style copy methods (withAlignment, withStyler, withMinWidth, withMaxWidth). TDD: write tests first, then implement.

milestones.title: GridModel + DefaultGridModel
milestones.description: GridListener functional interface. GridModel<T> interface. DefaultGridModel<T> with CopyOnWriteArrayList backing. TDD: write tests first, then implement.

milestones.title: DataGrid Widget — Core Rendering
milestones.description: DataGrid<T> extends AbstractComponent. Column width computation, frozen header row, data row rendering with alignment, format string application, per-cell styler, selected row highlighting. TDD.

milestones.title: DataGrid Widget — Scrolling + Selection
milestones.description: Vertical scrolling (arrows, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, Ctrl+P/N/V). Horizontal scrolling (Shift+arrows). Selection management, selection listeners, ensureVisible. TDD.

milestones.title: DataGrid Widget — Thread Safety + Edge Cases
milestones.description: Concurrent add + draw, empty model, single row, wide content truncation, narrow viewport, null values, model swap. TDD.

milestones.title: Demo + Integration
milestones.description: Add DataGrid demo to BasicWidgetsDemo. Add to widget coverage tests. Verify full test suite passes.
